tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Streamlit backgroundColor.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Sidebar, inputs, code blocks, table headers. Streamlit secondaryBackgroundColor and codeBackgroundColor.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Panels that sit on paper: evidence panel, relationship rows, SQL result frame.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel outlines. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on paper, paper-sunk and paper-raised. Streamlit borderColor.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on paper, paper-sunk and paper-raised. Streamlit textColor.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, captions, table headers on paper, paper-sunk and paper-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, units and separators on paper, paper-sunk and paper-raised. Smallest text allowed is 12px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, selected state, running step. Streamlit primaryColor. Use sparingly: one primary action per view.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Background of the running-step row and of declared tags. Text on it: ink or accent.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid outline, 2px offset. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: edge-declared
tokens.usage: Graph edge and tag for a declared FK. Solid 2px line. Same hue as accent on purpose: declared means certain.

tokens.name: edge-accepted
tokens.usage: Graph edge and tag for a manual or accepted relationship. Solid 3px line, so it differs from declared in weight and lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: edge-inferred
tokens.usage: Graph edge for a suggested (javasolt) relationship. Dashed 2px line, dash 6 gap 4. Rejected edges are hidden.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Text and marker for kész, elfogadott, high value match. Always next to a word. On paper, paper-raised and ok-wash.

tokens.name: ok-wash
tokens.usage: Background of an ok tag. Text on it: ok or ink.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Text and marker for uncertainty: low value match, feltételezett claims, nincs elég információ. On paper, paper-raised and warn-wash.

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Background of an abstention notice or a warning tag. Text on it: warn or ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Text and marker for hiba, elutasított, refused queries, destructive buttons. Always next to a word. On paper, paper-raised and danger-wash.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Background of an error tag or a refused-query notice. Text on it: danger or ink.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A számla a CustomerId oszlopon keresztül kapcsolódik a vevőhöz.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines, captions, table cells in dense lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and tag text. Sentence case in the UI; the sample is uppercase only to show the cut.

styles.name: ident
styles.usage: Table and column names wherever they appear in prose, tags or paths.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Generated SQL, tool-call arguments, log lines (st.code).

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Counts in the pipeline stat strip (st.metric value). Tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a marker and its word; tag padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding (horizontal); gap between inline items in a join path.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in step lists and relationship lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between stacked panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap above a page section heading.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, identifier chips, code spans.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, panels. Streamlit baseRadius.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status markers only (the small dot before kész).
